description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the MaintenanceService in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing employee data access and related functionalities within the Maintenance plugin.

classes.name: MaintenanceServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the MaintenanceService related to employee data retrieval and associated functionalities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of MaintenanceService, populates test data, and mocks necessary services.

methods.name: testAccessEmployeeData
methods.description: Tests retrieval of comprehensive employee data, verifying various attributes in the returned dataset.

methods.name: testReportTo
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of supervisor and subordinate data for an employee.

methods.name: testEmpPicture
methods.description: Tests fetching of employee picture data.

methods.name: testEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee attachment data.

methods.name: testEmpDependent
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee dependents data.

methods.name: testEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Verifies language proficiency data of employee.

methods.name: testEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests license data associated with employee.

methods.name: testEmpLocations
methods.description: Checks location data associated with employee.

methods.name: testUser
methods.description: Verifies user account data associated with employee.

methods.name: testLeave
methods.description: Checks leave details such as date and duration.

methods.name: testGetPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Verifies the list of entities that can be purged for GDPR compliance.

methods.name: testGetAccessStrategy
methods.description: Tests retrieval of access strategies for different data types.
